{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the treatment arm is correctly identified and check for missing values in 'responded'
print("Unique arms:", trial_df['arm'].unique())
print("Unique response values:", trial_df['responded'].unique())
print("Missing values in 'responded':", trial_df['responded'].isnull().sum())

# Subset only the treatment arm
treatment_arm = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Verify no missing 'responded' values in treatment arm
print("Missing values in 'responded' for treatment arm:", treatment_arm['responded'].isnull().sum())

# Compute the fraction of responders in the treatment arm
treatment_responders = treatment_arm['responded'].sum()
treatment_total = len(treatment_arm)
fraction_responded = treatment_responders / treatment_total

fraction_responded"}
